description: Fork of exp497 (relu_norm). gate_mode=gelu_norm: g=GELU(ts+b)/sum(GELU(ts+b)). GELU's smooth tail gives NONZERO gradient to all rows (no ReLU dead-row sparsity, ~97% rows nonzero) AND normalized (no common-mode). Aims to match softmax (exp493 1.4806) by recovering BOTH its properties (normalized + dense-gradient) that relu_norm (exp497, +0.085 vs softmax) and relu (exp496) lacked. relu_bias per-table no-wd.
